# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is a style prototype of the book. It has the same theme, sidebar and
contents as the real book, but no R code runs, so it renders in seconds. Use it
to try layout ideas before they reach the real chapters.

The pages exercise what the real book uses: parts, numbered chapters, nested
sections, cross-references between pages, callouts, code with output, tables,
display math and citations [@pesaran2015; @croissant2019].

## What to look at

- The left sidebar: the open chapter unfolds into its sections.
- The right contents: two levels, only the current group expanded.
- Links between pages: @sec-cd-test in one chapter, @sec-ips in another, and
  the appendix @sec-cd-theory.
- Footnotes and index terms: the notes in @sec-dependence and the dotted
  terms open alone in the right-hand pane; the entries live in the
  [Index](glossary.qmd).
